basics.name: Wanqing (Psyche) He
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Information Science (HCI) at Cornell University. Researching AI-Mediated Communication, cognitive scaffolding, and psycholinguistic metrics for evaluating AI-integrated spoken communication.

work.summary: Architected a real-time AI-MC system utilizing LLM-based cognitive scaffolding; recruited & directed a 19-person cross-functional team.
Architected content moderation framework for AI models across TikTok, Helo, Fictum (>500M users).
Built the first Mandarin NLU model for Facebook AI Assistant chatbot.
